Privacy Policy

We are finalising the exhaustive privacy policy for 69Shop.in. Until the full legal copy goes live, please email support@69shop.in for any questions about how we collect, store, and process your data.

Key points already enforced:

  • All passwords and authentication tokens are handled by Firebase Authentication.
  • Concierge forms sync to Firestore and are never sold to third parties.
  • You can request account deletion anytime via support.
